title: 1.1 Using "h" and "p" elements for headings and paragraphs
description_md:
# Task Description: Please use HTML tags to build a simple page structure, including a main heading, subheading, and body paragraphs. The goal is to become familiar with the usage of common structural tags `

`, `

`, and `

`. ## Requirements: 1. Use an `

` element to create a main heading with the content "Beginner's Guide to Front-end Development". 2. Use an `

` element below the main heading to create a subheading with the content "HTML Basic Structure". 3. Use a `

` element below the subheading to create a paragraph with the content "This article will introduce how to use HTML to build the basic structure of a web page." 4. Maintain clear tag hierarchy and do not add any unrelated content.

start_code.html:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Programming Learning Tutorial</title>
</head>
<body>
    # Please add your code here!
</body>
</html>

checkpoints.name: h2 Element Existence Check
checkpoints.feedback: Please add an h2 element to your code.

checkpoints.name: h2 Element Content Check
checkpoints.feedback: The content of the h2 element should be 'Beginner's Guide to Front-end Development'.

checkpoints.name: h4 Element Existence Check
checkpoints.feedback: Please add an h4 element to your code.

checkpoints.name: h4 Element Position Check
checkpoints.script: const h2 = document.querySelector('h2'); const h4 = document.querySelector('h4'); if (!h2 || !h4) { return false; } const elements = Array.from(document.body.children); const h2Index = elements.indexOf(h2); const h4Index = elements.indexOf(h4); return h2Index !== -1 && h4Index > h2Index;
checkpoints.feedback: The h4 element should be below the h2 element.

checkpoints.name: h4 Element Content Check
checkpoints.feedback: The content of the h4 element should be 'HTML Basic Structure'.

checkpoints.name: p Element Existence Check
checkpoints.feedback: Please add a p element to your code.

checkpoints.name: p Element Position Check
checkpoints.script: const h4 = document.querySelector('h4'); const p = document.querySelector('p'); if (!h4 || !p) { return false; } const elements = Array.from(document.body.children); const h4Index = elements.indexOf(h4); const pIndex = elements.indexOf(p); return h4Index !== -1 && pIndex > h4Index;
checkpoints.feedback: The p element should be below the h4 element.

checkpoints.name: p Element Content Check
checkpoints.value: This article will introduce how to use HTML to build the basic structure of a web page.
checkpoints.feedback: The content of the p element should be 'This article will introduce how to use HTML to build the basic structure of a web page.'
